'''Waterlamp''' is a [[Common enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|A wild arthropod that lives in aquatic environments. The waterlamp gives off a faint glow and its body fluids contain irritants that may induce allergic reactions and even burns. Be careful when tackling this creature.}}

==Overview==
Wildlife creatures that resemble a lamp, Waterlamps are not much of a dangerous foe, but they often appear in groups, helping other enemies by decreasing the defense of Operators.
*Attacks with a bubble barrage, each one dealing Nature damage and appling one stack of DEF reduction.
*Swipes and deals Physical damage.
*Spew acid after a wind up, dealing Nature damage and appling five stacks of DEF reduction in an area.

Each stack reduces an Operator's Defense by 10%.
